# Cosmic Studio — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md): it is the single source of truth for commands, architecture, conventions and
workflows in this repository. [`GUIDELINES.md`](../GUIDELINES.md) covers UI principles, coding standards and the
manual validation checklist, and [`DESIGN_GUIDELINE.md`](../DESIGN_GUIDELINE.md) must be read before any UI work.

Never cancel long-running commands (`yarn install`, `yarn build`, `yarn coverage`): wait them out.
